entries.title: Psalms 34:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David; when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.>> I will bless Jehovah at all times; his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 34:2
segments: My soul shall make its boast in Jehovah: the meek shall hear, and rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 34:3
segments: Magnify Jehovah with me, and let us exalt his name together.

entries.title: Psalms 34:4
segments: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

entries.title: Psalms 34:5
segments: They looked unto him, and were enlightened, and their faces were not confounded.

entries.title: Psalms 34:6
segments: This afflicted one called, and Jehovah heard [him], and saved him out of all his troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 34:7
segments: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.

entries.title: Psalms 34:8
segments: Taste and see that Jehovah is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him!

entries.title: Psalms 34:9
segments: Fear Jehovah, ye his saints; for there is no want to them that fear him.

entries.title: Psalms 34:10
segments: The young lions are in need and suffer hunger; but they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good.

entries.title: Psalms 34:11
segments: ¶Come, ye sons, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 34:12
segments: What man is he that desireth life, [and] loveth days, that he may see good?

entries.title: Psalms 34:13
segments: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile;

entries.title: Psalms 34:14
segments: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

entries.title: Psalms 34:15
segments: The eyes of Jehovah are upon the righteous, and his ears are toward their cry;

entries.title: Psalms 34:16
segments: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth:

entries.title: Psalms 34:17
segments: [The righteous] cry, and Jehovah heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 34:18
segments: Jehovah is nigh to those that are of a broken heart, and saveth them that are of a contrite spirit.

entries.title: Psalms 34:19
segments: Many are the adversities of the righteous, but Jehovah delivereth him out of them all:

entries.title: Psalms 34:20
segments: He keepeth all his bones; not one of them is broken.

entries.title: Psalms 34:21
segments: Evil shall destroy the wicked; and they that hate the righteous shall bear their guilt.

entries.title: Psalms 34:22
segments: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; and none of them that trust in him shall bear guilt.
